question: Where is gallery located inside a 180 kilometers radius on the way from Gary Lapelusa Landscaping LLC, Bayonne, NJ to Stanford in New York Center, New York, NY?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-74.122011 40.662412)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.989774 40.739706)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE tourism = 'gallery'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-74.122011 40.662412)',4326)::geography, 180000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-74.122011 40.662412)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
